claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, RS-67506 is a 5-HT4 partial agonist with additional sigma-1/sigma-2 affinity but no DNA-damaging, tubulin, kinase, or other cytotoxic mechanism, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
